segments.name: Data Capture and Delivery Solutions
segments.description: Provider of cordless data capture devices with barcode scanning or RFID/NFC technologies for mobile workforce applications.
segments.evidence: Our primary products are cordless data capture devices incorporating barcode scanning or RFID/Near Field Communications (NFC) technologies that connect over Bluetooth.

revenueModel.text: App providers and resellers purchase data capture devices and software integration kits to integrate into mobile applications for their end customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are integrated in their application solutions and are marketed by the app providers or the resellers of their applications.
